tasks.goal: M4 code demo: local-cli registry target codex writes under writeRoots
nonGoals: Do not claim a live Codex model session when the binary is absent
acceptance: MODE file records live or standin

argv: mkdir -p .cliyard/mvp-code-demo && if command -v codex >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo live > .cliyard/mvp-code-demo/MODE.txt; codex --version > .cliyard/mvp-code-demo/RESULT.txt 2>&1 || echo 'codex-present-but-failed' > .cliyard/mvp-code-demo/RESULT.txt; else echo standin > .cliyard/mvp-code-demo/MODE.txt; echo 'codex-standin: binary not on PATH' > .cliyard/mvp-code-demo/RESULT.txt; fi
